title: Mtoni Fever Response
description: Plan fictional community prevention and clinic readiness improvements with delayed effects.

events.message: A fictional rain event disrupts one planned activity.
The school asks how handwashing access will be maintained.
A fictional supply delivery arrives later than expected.
The community reviews confirmed readiness changes.

learning_objectives: Explain why infrastructure improvements may have delayed effects.
Compare safe-water, handwashing and clinic-readiness trade-offs.
Use the event log to distinguish a game index from health data.

en: Some plans take one turn before their index changes.
Water, handwashing and clinic readiness are separate measures.
Read the pending effects and the event for this turn.
sw: Baadhi ya mipango huchukua zamu moja kuanza kuleta mabadiliko.
Maji, unawaji mikono na kliniki ni vipimo tofauti.
Soma athari zinazosubiri na tukio la zamu hii.
